name: server
description: Generic HTTP companion service for the collector - the one piece of this repo that needs to run continuously (a long-lived process, not a one-shot CLI script), so it's a separate deployable package from the root scripts. app.ts is a small generic JSON-in/JSON-out router (auth + routing + parsing); routes/ holds each use case's actual logic (currently just on-demand listing refresh). Still imports shared logic (db.ts, browser.ts, check-listings.ts, ...) from ../src rather than duplicating it.
